name: Frameleaf
description: Frameleaf is a self-hosted photo and video library with native apps, private face and smart search, photo and video editing, and optional cloud backup. It is an open-source (AGPLv3) fork of Immich and is currently in beta.
seoDescription: Self-hosted photo and video library (beta, fork of Immich) with face and smart search, photo and video editing. Deploy with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes.
